title: E4-R87 Phase A — frozen zero-call replay case selection (digest-bound before execution)

selectionRule.universe: R85 attributed dev-set only: the 54 non-holdout records in docs/evidence/e4-r85-failure-taxonomy.json under suites regression/adversarial/stress. R83 holdout per-case data is NEVER read (only aggregate 9/32 in historical background).
selectionRule.ruleT: Select EVERY case whose recorded fingerprint equals the confirmed H2 target fingerprint c1aae66dc97dd795d058737188f59d9a4ccf0da41b3b0054eb86d5c3f14b28d8 (the progress-blind identical-call gate). No cherry-picking: all matching cases are included (exactly 3).
selectionRule.ruleC: Deterministic counterexamples, one per recorded termination class that is NOT caused by the target mechanism, selected by smallest recorded toolCalls (tie-break: lexicographic caseId): (1) tool_limit WITH tool_failures>0 (MODEL_BEHAVIOR, H2 record's own named counterexample class), (2) verified_complete, (3) agent_limit (iteration budget). These must be outcome-invariant across arms.
selectionRule.traceRule: Each case's replay trace is a minimal scripted reproduction of its recorded termination class (identical calls for tool_limit; different-args calls for verified_complete; text-steps for agent_limit). Replay is a MECHANISM replay (same as E4-R86), not a literal transcript replay: the committed taxonomy records signatures, not transcripts.
selectionRule.armRule: Both arms run the same runner with identical identity, limits (maxRepeatedIdenticalToolCalls=3, maxStallRecoveries=1, maxPatternStallRecoveries=1, default stall patterns, maxIterationsPerTurn=20, maxParallelToolCalls=1) and the same case order. The ONLY difference is the pre-declared fix: baseline arm feeds NO result fingerprint (pre-R86 streak semantics, byte-identical to source SHA e9776ba); candidate arm feeds the R86 result fingerprint (source SHA a203737).
selectionRule.noSwapRule: This list is frozen and digest-bound BEFORE any replay executes; cases may not be swapped after candidate results are seen.
selectionRule.failClosedRule: The runner recomputes this digest from the committed file and aborts on mismatch (plan R87 #5).
